title: 持续设计验收 / continuous design acceptance
finalCompletionEvidenceText: 每模板标准/坏例，开发期人工修图不计自动成功 (roadmap §10 Z12)
whyM3: M3 closes the base thirty scenarios and base twenty templates, so the per-template standard and bad-example requirement becomes checkable across the whole base set for the first time.

criteria.assertion: Every template in the base set has one standard example and at least one bad example frozen before any result, and the pair is identified by template id plus revision.
criteria.recompute: Walk the template definitions across the three faces and assert each base template has a frozen standard row and at least one bad-example row with distinct ids.
criteria.thresholdOrigin: inherited from the frozen v1 target block by reference; no new numeric threshold is introduced in this batch

criteria.assertion: Development-time manual repair is never counted as an automatic success; a repaired row is booked as regression and a fresh unseen set is required for a generalisation claim.
criteria.recompute: Compare the repair ledger against the success ledger and assert no row appears in both; assert the generalisation statement cites a different unseen set.
criteria.thresholdOrigin: inherited from the frozen v1 target block by reference; no new numeric threshold is introduced in this batch

criteria.assertion: Every acceptance row carries an evidence level (DECLARED, SOURCE VERIFIED, RUNTIME VERIFIED, E2E VERIFIED, INDEPENDENTLY ACCEPTED) or the explicit NOT VERIFIED marker; blocked rows stay in the denominator.
criteria.recompute: Recount rows by evidence level and assert the sum equals the total row count and that no row is level-less; assert blocked and deferred rows are still counted.
criteria.thresholdOrigin: inherited from the frozen v1 target block by reference; no new numeric threshold is introduced in this batch

criteria.assertion: Reviewer discipline stays as frozen: at least two independent reviewers, five-point scale, mean at least 4, no item below 3, with scientific correctness judged separately and never offset by appearance.
criteria.recompute: Assert reviewer count and scale equality with the inherited v1 target block; assert a scientific failure cannot be averaged away by a visual pass.
criteria.thresholdOrigin: inherited from the frozen v1 target block by reference; no new numeric threshold is introduced in this batch

criteria.assertion: Error expression and error computation are booked on separate rows for every uncertainty-bearing template, so a visualisation pass never closes a computation row.
criteria.recompute: Assert the two row ids are distinct for TS10 and any uncertainty row; assert the computation row remains NOT VERIFIED when the expression row passes.
criteria.thresholdOrigin: inherited from the frozen v1 target block by reference; no new numeric threshold is introduced in this batch

deferredScopeNote: Reviewer recruitment, blind ordering and the professional panel are execution-side activities of a later batch; these criteria freeze only what will be checked and how.
